continuity_contract.current_milestone: Clear the fixed ContextBench contract through frozen evidence-led rounds while keeping its diagnostic distinct from semantic retention and repair correctness.
continuity_contract.enduring_objective: Improve reusable ARE reasoning, useful continuity, recovery, correctness and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
continuity_contract.initial_objective: Finish GLM-5.3-flash qualification, beginning with the 8K small context window and useful reasoning-state recovery under pressure.
continuity_contract.research_method: objective → gap → question → competing hypotheses → selection → experiment/tasks/criteria → results → observations → reviewed decision → successor

dataset_refs: same frozen exposed eight-task cohort; Round 12 remains historical counterevidence
experiment_template.research_question: Does separating durable evidence from exploratory process history remove the task-dependent harm observed with full one-shot state?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycle-boundary presentation.
Any within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, or non-state mechanism change.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.

records.falsifier: Evidence-only state loses required recovery information, creates any unsupported fact, fails integrity or completion gates, uses at least as many aggregate model tokens as Round 12 state, or misses the frozen +0.05 paired span-F1 target without file/validity degradation.
records.mechanism: Keep the objective digest, exact receipt-bound source evidence, recovery handles, truncation facts and limitations. Omit the ordered tool-outcome history from the model-facing projection while retaining it in the deterministic ledger for validation and recovery.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: At GLM-5.3-flash 8K recycle boundaries, projecting durable observed evidence without replaying exploratory tool-outcome chronology improves ContextBench continuity because it preserves source grounding while reducing anchoring on failed or superseded search paths.

records.research_question: Does separating durable evidence from exploratory process history remove the task-dependent harm observed with full one-shot state?
stop_conditions: Any outcome chronology in model-facing state, missing/duplicate presentation, unknown usage, false fact/source credit, terminal effect, or correction above one is an instrument failure.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state mechanism, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every outcome.

success_criteria.scope: Exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K evidence/process separation development evidence only; no confirmation, larger-window, semantic-retention, repair-correctness, transfer, or clearance claim.

records.claim: Seven cells were accounted before a dispatched stateless tokenizer request failed with zero response bytes. One pair favored evidence-only state by +0.0973 span F1, while two other treatment cells lost valid completion relative to control. Only one pair completed, so H23 is decision-ineligible.
limitations: Native selection does not establish correctness or semantic retention.

records.next_action: Preserve H23 unchanged. Add at most one identical-body retry only for a stateless tokenizer request-failed event with zero response bytes, record both attempts, and freeze a new v3-bound replication. Model requests remain single-attempt.
